info.title: Printarr
info.description:
Queue receipt tickets for the Epson TM-T88V. Clients send plain text. The API picks a
template for the recipient, renders the receipt, and prints it when it is due.

There is no authentication. Run it on the home LAN only.

Template choice: pass `template` to pick one explicitly from that recipient's group.
If you leave it out, a local decision model picks one when it is configured. Otherwise
a fixed rule picks one.

schema.title: Response List Templates Api V1 Templates Get

get.description: Slot templates: fill their slots and POST them to /api/v1/tickets/slots.

schema.title: Response List Slot Templates Api V1 Slot Templates Get

get.description: The slots of a slot template as JSON Schema: names, types, limits and descriptions.

schema.title: Response Slot Template Schema Api V1 Templates  Template Id  Schema Get

post.description: Queue a slot ticket. Slots are checked first; a bad slot returns 422 with each problem.
Queue a ticket. The template is chosen now, so printing needs no more work.

schema.title: Response List Tickets Api V1 Tickets Get

post.description: Release a held ticket. It prints within seconds, since its template is already chosen.

get.description: The block catalogue: each type, what it is for, its moods and where its slot schema is.

schema.title: Response List Blocks Api V1 Blocks Get

get.description: The slots of one block type as JSON Schema.

schema.title: Response Block Schema Route Api V1 Blocks  Name  Schema Get

post.description: Queue a composed ticket: blocks stacked in order on one card shell. Blocks are checked first.
Print this person's pile as strips, cutting after each. Only this person's tickets go on a strip.

schema.title: Response Release Person Api V1 People  Person  Release Post

post.description: Release every held ticket with this key. Home Assistant can call this on arrival.

schema.title: Response Release Hold Api V1 Holds  Hold Key  Release Post

get.description:
Numeric Home Assistant entities for a briefing, most notable first.

Each item has the current value, 30-day mean and spread, a z-score, a 7-day trend and
a plain reason. Hermes picks the graph slots from this list. Cached for five minutes.

schema.title: Response Insight Entities Api V1 Insights Entities Get

put.description: Change the decision model. Saved in the database, so it survives restarts.

get.description: For Uptime Kuma. Returns 503 when the printer or database is down.
Download a consistent copy of the whole database (tickets and settings) as an .db file.

post.description:
Replace the database with a file from /backup/export. Send the raw file as the body.

The current database is kept first as backups/pre-import-*.db. Any schema upgrade runs
after the copy. Use confirm=replace so a stray request cannot wipe the data by accident.

schema.title: Response Import Backup Api V1 Backup Import Post

put.description: Set the Telegram bot token and chat ID. Send an empty string to clear a value.

schema.title: Response Test Alert Api V1 Alerts Test Post

put.description: Home Assistant base URL and long-lived access token. Empty string clears a value.

schema.title: Response Test Ha Api V1 Settings Ha Test Post

post.description: Choose a template and render a receipt without queueing it.

get.description: Every ticket, oldest first, with the kind, tone, template, choice source and timings.

schema.title: Response Log List Api V1 Log Get

get.description: Counts by kind, tone, template, status and choice source, to see what is used.

schema.title: Response Log Summary Api V1 Log Summary Get

get.description: Every ticket in the log as CSV or JSON, for tuning the templates from real use.

post.description: Cancel a ticket that has not been printed yet.
Queue a failed or cancelled ticket again, to print now.

get.description: The exact ESC/POS byte stream for this ticket. The simulator reads this.

post.description: Print a test receipt right away. Returns 502 if the printer is unreachable.

get.description:
Check the link and read the printer's status bytes. Prints nothing.

`faults` are the blocking keys the queue pauses for. `unanswered` lists keys whose
status request got no reply, so they could not be checked.

schema.title: Response Printer Self Check Api V1 Printer Self Check Get

get.description: Counters since start: tickets printed, failures, dead letters, interrupted jobs, pauses.

schema.title: Response Get Metrics Api V1 Metrics Get

telegram_token_hint.title: Telegram Token Hint
telegram_token_hint.description: Last four characters of the bot token, never the full token.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Ordered blocks, each {type, mood, slots}. See GET /api/v1/blocks for types and moods.

token_hint.title: Token Hint
token_hint.description: Last four characters of the access token, never the full token.

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example http://192.0.2.231:11434/v1. Empty means rules only.

model.title: Model
model.description: Decision model: picks templates and decorations. For example d1:latest.

text_model.title: Text Model
text_model.description: Text model for paragraphs, used later. For example granite4.2:3b.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Why the strip is printed, kept in the log.

text.title: Text
text.description: The receipt as it would be printed, as plain text.

template.title: Template
template.description: A slot template id from GET /api/v1/slot-templates: 101 Briefing, 102 Note.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: The slots, see the template's schema.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: As for /tickets: now, at, or on_release (the recipient's pile).

hold.title: Hold
hold.description: Keep the ticket until released, as for /tickets.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: A second request with the same key returns the first ticket and prints nothing new.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Home Assistant blocks printed after the slots, read at print time, as for /tickets.

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.description: A fixed recipient: yannic or wife.

text_state.title: Text State
text_state.description: 'formatted' prints the text exactly as sent. 'unformatted' (for example speech-to-text) is first cleaned up by the text model. If the model is down, the text is sent as it is.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: Who asked for the ticket, for the log. For example home-assistant or hermes.

template.title: Template
template.description: A template id from GET /api/v1/templates, which must belong to the recipient's group, or 'auto' to let the decision model or the rules choose. Chosen when the request arrives, not when it prints.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the ticket is for. Left out, the template's kind is used, or 'note'.

from_user.title: From User
from_user.description: The person who wrote it, when it is a message to the other person.

to_user.title: To User
to_user.description: The person it is for. With from_user, it is an inbox item.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: now: print and cut at once. at: print at send_at. on_release: wait in the recipient's pile and print with their next POST /api/v1/people/{person}/release. Omitted, it is at when send_at is set, otherwise now.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Live data from Home Assistant, fetched when the request arrives. 'value' prints a label and state. 'sparkline' prints a labelled graph of recent history.

send_at.title: Send At
send_at.description: When to print, as ISO 8601. Values without a timezone use the server's PRINTARR_TIMEZONE. Omit to print as soon as possible. Cannot be combined with hold.

hold.title: Hold
hold.description: Keep the ticket until POST /tickets/{id}/release or /holds/{hold_key}/release.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Makes the request safe to repeat, for example after a timeout. A second request with the same key returns the first ticket and prints nothing new. Use one key per logical ticket, such as morning:yannic:2026-10-26.

hold_key.title: Hold Key
hold_key.description: Name for a group of held tickets, for example user-home. Used by /holds/{hold_key}/release.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: What was shortened to fit, for composed tickets.
